options.description: Blocking questions are always asked at once. When non-blocking ones wait too, the first question offers a choice: answer them all now, or a few at a time by principle. It says which it recommends and why (all now when there are few or they're closely linked, paced when there are many), and you pick. Recommended because it matches 'give the option depending on the situation'.
options.label: Offer the pacing choice (Recommended)

options.description: Each question shows its options with one recommended, and you always choose; pacing stays as it is (blocking at once, the rest three a turn by principle). Your words would then be about how each question is asked, not about how many are asked at once.
options.label: Recommend per question, you choose

options.description: Neither reading fits; you'll say it in your own words.
options.label: Something else

payload.question: When the clarifier has several questions that change what gets built, which reading of your words is right?
